archetypes.name: Tree Farm VP Maximizer
archetypes.philosophy: Focus on planting as many trees as possible to maximize bullet income and aggressively donate for Victory Points, minimizing unit production to prioritize economy.
key_changes: Modify BulletSpending.plantTree() to attempt planting in more directions and earlier in the round.
Update BulletSpending.donateForVP() to donate when bullets > 100 instead of 200.
Reduce unit building in BulletSpending.buildRobot() to only build after round 2000 and rarely.
Increase gardener hiring frequency by modifying tryHireGardener to try multiple directions.
Adjust Gardener to prioritize planting over watering if no low-health trees.
archetypes.engagement_style: Static defense, maintaining tree farms while donating bullets.

archetypes.name: Tank Blitzkrieg
archetypes.philosophy: Build tanks early and aggressively, using their strength to push through defenses and eliminate enemy units, focusing on map control through brute force.
key_changes: Change BulletSpending.buildRobot() to prioritize TANK building starting from round 500.
Modify BulletSpending.spendPolicy() to reserve bullets for tank production over trees.
Update Tank.defensiveMove() to instead move towards enemy center.
Reduce tree planting in BulletSpending.plantTree() to only when excess bullets.
Set unit priority to tanks, no other units.
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive pushes towards enemy base, using tanks to clear paths and ram trees.

archetypes.name: Scout Swarm Disrupter
archetypes.philosophy: Swarm with cheap scouts to harass enemy gardeners, steal bullets from trees, and pressure archons, disrupting economy for VP or elimination win.
key_changes: Alter BulletSpending.buildRobot() to build only SCOUT units frequently.
Modify Scout.fire() to target gardeners over archons.
Update Scout movement in runScout() to patrol towards enemy locations.
Reduce tree planting to fund more scouts.
Prioritize scout movement through trees without fear.
archetypes.engagement_style: Harass enemy gardeners and trees, forcing them to defend rather than expand.

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Cleaver Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Deploy lumberjacks early to clear tree obstacles and strike enemy units, enabling quicker army movements and disrupting enemy setups.
key_changes: Build LUMBERJACKs from round 400 in BulletSpending.buildRobot().
Modify runLumberjack() to move towards enemy center instead of base.
Use strike on nearby enemies without building robots.
Delay gardeners and trees until later.
Prioritize lumberjack production.
archetypes.engagement_style: Early rushes to clear paths and attack adjacent units.

archetypes.name: Soldier Horde
archetypes.philosophy: Spam soldiers to overwhelm opponents with numbers, using area shots efficiently when clustered for massive damage output.
key_changes: Change BulletSpending.buildRobot() to build SOLDIER predominantly.
Update Soldier.fire() to use triad/pentad more aggressively.
Modify Soldier movement to group near enemies.
Reduce other units and trees.
Movement towards enemy for positioning.
archetypes.engagement_style: Mass assaults with soldiers, positioning for optimal shot coverage.

archetypes.name: Economic Late-Scaler
archetypes.philosophy: Invest heavily in trees for late-game bullet reserves, then convert to VP to win before opponent builds army.
key_changes: Delay BulletSpending.buildRobot() to round 2500.
Maximize BulletSpending.plantTree() attempts.
Aggressive donation in donateForVP() when bullets >150.
Build mixed units late.
Extend tree growing period.
archetypes.engagement_style: Turtling and scaling economy for VP win.

archetypes.name: Gardener Expansion
archetypes.philosophy: Hire many gardeners to expand control, planting fewer trees per gardener for wider coverage, building small balanced armies.
key_changes: Increase gardener hiring in runArchon().
Modify BulletSpending.plantTree() to plant in fewer directions.
Build balanced units in buildRobot().
Move gardeners to new locations for expansion.
Maintain multiple tree clusters.
archetypes.engagement_style: Expansive base building with defensive patrols.

archetypes.name: Archon Assassin Rush
archetypes.philosophy: All-in early with soldiers and lumberjacks to rush and kill enemy archons quickly, preventing them from building economy.
key_changes: Build SOLDIER and LUMBERJACK from round 300.
Skip trees initially in plantTree().
Move aggressively towards enemy archons.
Target archons in firing.
No VP donation.
archetypes.engagement_style: Full commitment to early archon elimination.

archetypes.name: Mobile Flanker Army
archetypes.philosophy: Use mobile scouts and soldiers to roam, find weak spots, and ambush enemy units while avoiding direct confrontations.
key_changes: Build SCOUT and SOLDIER, avoid tanks.
Update movement to patrol with enemy bias.
Use Nav.tryMoveBug() towards enemy.
Flexible firing.
Reduce static defense.
archetypes.engagement_style: Mobile hit-and-run tactics, flanking and ambushing.

archetypes.name: Pure VP Rusher
archetypes.philosophy: Minimize all unit production and focus purely on bullet generation for rapid VP donation to end the game quickly.
key_changes: No unit building in buildRobot().
Maximize gardeners and trees.
Donate aggressively when cost is low.
Stop planting when VP close.
No army units.
